purpose: Observe registered callbacks in an already running approved process without attaching a debugger or forcing target decisions. Separate runtime evidence must establish the actual normal path; static zero never establishes a runtime value.

static_basis.runtime_registration: FUN_01195380 receives outputs of SetFunctionAddresses, then writes callbacks
static_basis.limits: Slot target and actual target code/consumer semantics remain unknown; static zero is not the runtime value.

tool_contract.input: Exactly fixture|game plus one canonical decimal PID; no caller paths/addresses/ranges/hashes

profiles.name: fixture
profiles.source_sha256: fixed after deterministic own fixture build; embedded in observer at build time

checks: Exact main image path and final file-handle path, regular disk file, nonreparse target, i386 target architecture
Read-only image handle with share-read only, max16MiB source file, CNG SHA256 exact profile
Toolhelp observed module base/SizeOfImage under actual ASLR, fixed slot range without uint32 overflow
One ReadProcessMemory of exactly8bytes and process-liveness checks; no arbitrary memory range or retries
VirtualQueryEx of nonzero pointer values for memory-region metadata only; no dereference/code/string/IPC/session/commandline reads
tool_contract.process_rights: First QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION|SYNCHRONIZE for identity, then only after disk-file/path/hash guards QUERY_INFORMATION|VM_READ|SYNCHRONIZE; process creation times compared. No privilege adjustment.
tool_contract.outputs: Fixed numeric status, requested profile/PID, actual main-image base/size, pointer values and derived RVA if inside image, VirtualQueryEx region metadata, elapsed milliseconds; no paths/window titles/argv or raw payload
tool_contract.target_integrity: No attach/injection/patching/debugger flags, protection changes, target control/termination or unknown-process fallback. Existing protective decisions remain unchanged.
observation_limits: Single8byte read is not an atomic or enduring pair snapshot and does not prove callback invocation.
Disk-image SHA binding does not cryptographically attest mutable running pages; no code bytes read.
Synchronous local API calls have no hard wall-clock guarantee; hash-loop5second checks are best effort only.
Protected/denied/ambiguous/changed target or file guards stop, no fallback or forced branch.

fixture_contract: Original x86 console image with same slot RVA; sets two own function pointers then naturally exits0 after30seconds, no network/account/IPC or user data. Normal Windows validation must precede any game observation.
current_stage: Prepare source, compile, verify deterministic identities/PE/API footprint and static byte anchors. Mac locked; no guest execution, target observation or instrumented-game result.
host_validation: Native C boundary checks and compiled PE/source review are preparation only, not Windows API/privacy/ASLR proof.
acceptance_remaining: Actual original fixture/observer Windows lifecycle, callback RVAs under ASLR and guard rejection cases
Fresh current game file/context/source authority and normal approved original flow before observing an existing PID
Actual consumer ownership/socket/frame/auth/state rules and independent playable game/platform/official acceptance
